title: PhoneClaw: Local Gemma 4 On-Device Agent for iOS
summary: An open-source iOS application that runs Gemma 4 models locally using LiteRT-LM and Metal acceleration for offline inference. It supports multimodal vision, agentic tool-use with native iOS apps, and optimized speculative decoding.
research_notes: Positioned as the primary reference for Gemma 4 on iOS due to delayed official support in Google's AI Edge Gallery for the platform; requires iPhone 15 Pro or newer for optimal performance.

evolution.summary: Evolved into a comprehensive local agent in 2026 with the release of Gemma 4, adding Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) for 37% faster inference and deep integration with iOS HealthKit and Contacts.
